Return the Mem enrichment matrix using column ranks

Source: R/jamenrich-enrichIMrank.R
enrichIMrank.Rd

Return the Mem enrichment matrix using column ranks, applying thresholds 'topEnrichN', 'min_count', and 'p_cutoff'.

Usage

enrichIMrank(x, topEnrichN = NULL, p_cutoff = NULL, min_count = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

Mem object

topEnrichN, p_cutoff, min_count

numeric values obtained from thresholds(x) by default, however they can be customized to determine updated ranks using the custom thresholds.

...

additional arguments are ignored.

Value

numeric matrix of numeric ranks by column. There should be no ties, all values should be integer.

Details

Ties are broken first by using enrichIMgeneCount then by using the current row and column order.

See also

Other jam Mem utilities: Mem-class, MemPlotFolio-class, fixSetLabels(), mem2cnet(), mem2emap()

Examples

enrichIMrank(Memtest, min_count=2)
